At the index level, Q3 expected earnings growth is very impressive, at +28.2 percent. This is 4.2x the 30-year historical average. 
- Four groups are creating this abnormally high earnings growth rate. High commodity prices are responsible for elevated earnings growth in Energy (+100.7 pct) and Materials (+30.7 pct). 
-Demand for AI-related hardware is helping Tech (+61.9 pct). A very large one-time GAAP charge in Q3 2025 at Meta is artificially inflating expected growth in Communications (+49.8 pct).
Looking forward, estimates continue to get pushed higher into 2027 at a historically unusual pace. 
@themarketear
